L105: The Show Chart winners (2026)
L106: ---
L107: 【37†The Show】 Chart is a 【38†music program】 【39†record chart】 on SBS Life that gives an award to the best-performing 【40†single】 of the week in South Korea.^{【41†[1]】} On June 2, 2026, The Show returned with a new season and revised format, following a hiatus since November 2025.^{【42†[2]】} Since July 2026, the show has been hosted by 【43†Flare U】's 【44†Chuei Liyu】 and 【45†Xikers】's Minjae.^{【46†[3]】}
